The code is **LXNE**.

The last four hidden neurons have identical outgoing weights across all nine outputs, so they add the same offset to every move’s score without changing the chosen move. This makes them a convenient hiding place.

Their largest input weights encode letters by column position, using A=1 through Z=26:

| Hidden neuron | Largest weight | Column (1-based) | Letter |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 33 | 2.451 | 12 | L |
| 34 | 2.382 | 24 | X |
| 35 | 2.415 | 14 | N |
| 36 | 2.399 | 5 | E |

CODE: LXNE
